The video segment features a person in a glasses store experimenting with a virtual glasses try-on machine before browsing through glasses and settling on a pair to purchase. The person, who has fair skin, red hair, a yellow beanie, and wears a checkered black and white scarf, is seen holding a purple smartphone and standing in front of a white machine that displays the person’s reflection. The person interacts with the try-on machine and it displays an error message in Japanese; ホームボタンを押さないで下さい (hōmubotan o osanaide kudasai) – "Please do not press the Home button." and 一人でお試しください (hitori de otameshi kudasai) - "Please try it alone" and ERROR. The setting is a brightly lit store with wooden floors, where various eyeglasses are neatly displayed on a long, light-colored wooden table. After the interaction with the virtual glasses machine, the camera pans along the wooden table to show the eyeglasses. The person can then be seen trying on glasses and holding them to the camera to gauge their appearance. Finally, the camera zooms in on a set of two eyeglasses with the price and an AUD/USD conversion displayed, before the person picks up one and decides to settle on it. The visual changes in the video are smooth and follow the person’s movements and interaction with the eyeglasses in the store.
